mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals tightening monetary policy, raising risk premiums and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the next month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or t-test p >0.05 showing no significant negative returns when triggered.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rates and rising demand (GDP growth) creates a favorable environment for equity valuation expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window when both FEDFUNDS <1.5% and GDPC1 >17286.497, or 20d returns not significantly higher than baseline when condition met.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, accommodative monetary policy (low FEDFUNDS) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE <4%) creates a favorable environment for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns not significantly positive in late-cycle regimes when UNRATE <4% and FEDFUNDS <0.5%, or t-test p>0.05 showing no effect.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden inflation spike above 250.0 in the CPIAUCSL index signals tight monetary policy or supply constraints, raising risk premiums and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 250.0 in the next month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or t-test p >0.05 showing no significant negative returns when triggered.

mechanism_narrative: Rising demand (HOUST) and expanding supply (INDPRO) both indicate a healthy economic cycle, lowering risk premiums and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive when both HOUST and INDPRO are above current values, or Rank IC <0.03 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDP growth (GDPC1) reflects robust demand, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60d returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment (UNRATE above 4.2%) signals weakening labor market conditions, raising risk premiums and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.2% in the next month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or t-test p>0.05 showing no significant negative returns when triggered.
